description: Extends the shared preset at yschimke/renovate-config, which owns the release-train grouping for the ee.schimke.composeai group: compose-ai-tools, compose-preview-daemon, compose-preview-contracts and rc-players each get a group of their own, so a BOM bump here rides the same group it does in the sibling repositories. The rules below are this repository's own.

packageRules.description: The design-render reusable workflow is pinned to a commit on compose-preview-server's main and bumped by the custom manager below, not the github-actions manager, which only tracks tags.

customManagers.description: Bump the pinned commit of compose-preview-server's reusable design-render workflow to the head of its main branch.
